lede: The People's March on Saturday is the community moment to watch this week — if something's on your mind about the direction things are heading, that's your chance to show up alongside your neighbors. The rest of the week leans into the holiday: Alpine Chapel's free Friendsgiving on Sunday, the Turkey Trot on Thanksgiving morning, and a handful of live music and community gatherings to carry you through to the long weekend. On the government side, four meetings are on the calendar, but none have posted agendas yet, so there's nothing to act on there right now.
